comparison_rules.confidence_intervals: two-sided 95% Student-t intervals over per-seed means/differences; Wilson interval for binary success rate
comparison_rules.effect_size: paired Hedges g_z with paired Cohen d_z also retained
comparison_rules.latency: conditional on each policy's successful user-time samples; per-seed means and pooled P95 with sample counts; no user-level paired test
comparison_rules.multiplicity: Holm correction separately over efficacy and resource/cost families across all confirmatory comparisons and scenes
comparison_rules.p_values: exact two-sided sign-flip randomization for continuous paired outcomes; exact McNemar/binomial tail for binary outcomes
comparison_rules.pairing: within seed and identical exogenous world trace
comparison_rules.unrecovered: remain failures; recovery-or-censoring time uses simulation horizon for paired comparison; recovered-only time reports n_success/n_total

hypotheses: Event replanning can improve response to exogenous changes at additional computation cost.
Longer horizons can improve foresight but increase candidate evaluation cost under a frozen-state forecast.
Direct/quantized candidate generation can change the chance of reaching useful relay geometry.
Switch suppression can reduce chattering but may delay response to a genuine rescue-service gain.
Energy preference can lower Wh while reducing rescue service; safety limits are never ablated.
Rescue priority can improve rescue service while reallocating capacity away from ordinary users.

mechanisms.battery_reserve: vary positive operational reserve while enforcing it in planner and execution
mechanisms.candidate_generation: remove direct pursuit headings or quantize C relay candidates; vary D grid shortlist and mesh step
mechanisms.energy: vary C's energy objective weight and D's ranking-only energy tie-break; do not remove energy/return constraints
mechanisms.event_replanning: disable event-triggered updates while retaining first and periodic decisions
mechanisms.prediction_horizon_steps: compare H=1,3,6; time step is 10 s, so horizons are 10/30/60 s
mechanisms.rescue_priority: reduce C rescue weight or remove D rescue lexicographic rank; runtime service and radio checks stay unchanged
mechanisms.target_switching: turn D switch suppression off or vary its tie-break penalty; hard feasibility remains active

role: one-factor ablations; formal C/D implementations remain unchanged
